audience: finance teams with company-scoped Mekari Jurnal API credentials

useCases.title: Review receivables and customer invoices
useCases.text: List sales invoices, inspect a selected invoice and review aged receivables before following up.

useCases.title: Check financial reports
useCases.text: Read the balance sheet, profit and loss report and cash flow for the selected reporting period.

useCases.title: Review supplier bills
useCases.text: List purchase invoices and inspect a bill alongside aged payables.

useCases.title: Create a customer or vendor
useCases.text: Review existing records, then create a customer or vendor when requested. This does not post an invoice or payment.
